Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Change Look
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Pokemon Eggventure — Change Look[/b][/size][/center]

[center][i]Your Abra can stay an Abra.[/i][/center]

An add-on for [b]Pokemon Eggventure[/b] that lets you pick the appearance of each animal yourself, one by one, with Robin's scissors.

[line]

[size=5][b]What it does[/b][/size]

In the main mod, a Pokémon changes appearance on its own once it likes you enough. That is still how it works — this add-on does not take it away.

What it adds is [b]choice[/b]. Every stage of a line becomes an appearance you can apply to any individual animal. Buy the scissors from Robin, use them on a Pokémon, and pick.

An Abra can stay an Abra, become a Kadabra, or become an Alakazam. The one standing next to it can be something else entirely.

[line]

[size=5][b]How much is covered[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]808 Pokémon[/b] have more than one appearance.[/*]
[*]248 of them offer [b]three[/b] — the whole line.[/*]
[*]560 offer [b]two[/b] — the young form and the adult one.[/*]
[*][b]1864 appearances[/b] in total.[/*]
[/list]
The Pokémon that only ever had one sprite are left alone, since there would be nothing to choose between.

[b]Shiny appearances stay with shiny Pokémon.[/b] A normal Abra will never be offered the shiny Alakazam look, and the other way around.

Babies always keep the look of the first stage, whichever appearance you picked for the adult.

[line]

[size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]

[b]EvolutionAuto[/b] — on by default, which keeps the automatic evolution from the main mod. Turn it off only if your scissors choice will not stick on an already evolved Pokémon, since the automatic change takes priority over appearances.

[b]PoidsAutresStades[/b] — the chance that a newly hatched Pokémon is born looking like another stage of its line. Zero by default, meaning never: you do the picking. Set it to 1 to give every stage the same odds.

[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Pokemon Eggventure 2.1.0 or later[/*]
[*]Alternative Textures 7.1.0 or later[/*]
[/list]
The scissors come from Alternative Textures and are sold by Robin.

[line]

[size=5][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Everyone in the save needs this add-on installed, otherwise the appearances you choose will not look the same on each screen.

Manifest.Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Change Look
Manifest.Description: Choisissez l'apparence de chaque Pokémon évolué, animal par animal, avec les ciseaux d'Alternative Textures.
